subject: REPOSITORY paragraph
notes: kb/Work PB1086: Rule (cite.py --check 12.3.8.4 'It is implementor-defined how the information in the class specifier and the external repository are used' -> OK §12.3.8.4 6)); Annex A.1 item 161 (required + documented). Code: OoNameResolution.Lookup resolves a class-specifier against the COMPILATION GROUP's OoClassTable only - by externalized name when AS literal-1 is written (FindByExternalizedName), else by the declared word; pinned by pb974_repository_as_phrase (CLASS BOXY AS "W974-BOX"). The in-group half is documented inside DOC-A.1-163's text ('GR6 / GR9 leave ... to the implementor, and matching the declared word keeps a same-word specifier working'). NOT covered: the rule's obligation is to use the specifier 'together with the external repository' - there is none (§8.13 unimplemented), so a class compiled in another compilation group can never be used (out/probe/repo/sr6.cob variant: CLASS NOSUCHCL + USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE NOSUCHCL -> COBOL0813 'no such a class or interface is defined in this compilation group'); and A.1 item 161 has no row of its own in docs/CONFORMANCE.md §7 (the inventory's DOC-A.1-161 is empty).
